Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: McClendon
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 10/28/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 1 as introduced provides for the reapportionment and redistricting of the state into districts for the purpose of electing members of the Alabama Senate. This bill will not affect state funding.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
